Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana is a Bihar government scheme aimed at the welfare and security of the girl child and her family, including support linked to the birth and marriage of a girl child. The scheme is implemented by the Women Development Corporation, Bihar.

Key Features

  • Financial assistance / incentive for families with a girl child
  • Support linked to birth registration and marriage of the girl child
  • Implemented through the Women Development Corporation, Patna

Exact amounts and eligibility criteria are as per the official notification on the state portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girl child born in a family below the state's income eligibility limit
  • Benefit linked to birth registration and marriage of the girl child
  • Applicants must be permanent residents of Bihar and not covered under similar schemes

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the Women Development Corporation, Bihar or the district women welfare office
  2. Submit the birth certificate and family details
  3. Benefits are released after verification as per the official portal

Kanya Sumangala Yojana is a flagship scheme of the Government of Uttar Pradesh to promote the well-being and education of the girl child and to improve the child sex ratio.

Key Highlights

  • Conditional financial assistance to girl children in families with up to two children
  • Benefits linked to birth registration and school enrolment/continuation
  • Implemented through the Women Welfare Department, Government of UP

How it Works

Assistance is released in instalments tied to milestones such as birth, immunisation, and admission to Class 1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11 and graduation, as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girl child born in a family with up to two children
  • Birth registered in a government hospital or empanelled facility
  • Family should not be an income tax payer and should meet the scheme's income norms

How to Apply

  1. Apply online through the UP Kanya Sumangala portal
  2. Fill the family and girl child details and upload documents
  3. Track instalments tied to milestones such as admission to Class 1, 6, 9, 12 and graduation

Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh government scheme to provide free coaching and mentorship to talented students from economically weaker and marginalised sections for various competitive and entrance examinations.

Key Highlights

  • Free coaching for civil services (IAS/IPS/PCS), engineering (JEE), medical (NEET), NDA, and other competitive exams
  • Coaching at district-level Abhyudaya centres and through empanelled institutions
  • Online and offline mentorship support

How it Works

Eligible students are selected and provided coaching at Abhyudaya centres established across UP districts, as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students who are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh
  • Belonging to economically weaker or marginalised sections as per the scheme
  • Qualifying performance in the prior examination and category criteria as notified

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district Abhyudaya centre or through the official portal
  2. Submit the application with previous examination marks and category documents
  3. Selected students are allotted coaching at the nearest centre

Uttar Pradesh e-District is the state citizen-services portal that delivers certificates and public services online, reducing the need to visit government offices.

Key Highlights

  • Caste, income, residence (domicile), birth and death certificates
  • Online application, status tracking and download of issued certificates
  • Integrated with CSC and district administration

How it Works

Citizens register on the portal, apply for the required service, upload documents and track the application to download the issued certificate.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all residents of Uttar Pradesh
  • Documents required vary by service, such as identity, address, and income proof
  • Aadhaar is used for authentication where required

How to Apply

  1. Register on the UP e-District portal
  2. Select the service and fill the online application
  3. Upload documents, pay the fee if applicable, and track the status
  4. Download the issued certificate once approved

Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana is the Uttar Pradesh state housing initiative to provide pucca houses and financial assistance to eligible poor and weaker-section families.

Key Highlights

  • Financial assistance / housing for eligible poor families
  • Convergent with Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana where applicable
  • Ownership preferential in the name of the woman of the household

How it Works

Eligible families apply through the gram panchayat / urban local body / housing department; assistance is released in instalments as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Poor and weaker-section families without a pucca house in UP
  • Identification through the state housing survey or SECC data
  • Priority for women-headed households and disadvantaged groups

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the gram panchayat, urban local body, or the state housing portal
  2. Submit beneficiary details and land documents
  3. Assistance is released in instalments linked to construction progress

UP Kisan Karj Mafi is a Uttar Pradesh government debt-relief scheme that waives eligible farm loans of small and marginal farmer families to reduce their financial distress.

Key Highlights

  • Waiver of eligible outstanding farm loans
  • Targeted at small and marginal farmers
  • Implemented through the Agriculture / cooperative departments, Government of UP

How it Works

Eligible farmers are identified and their qualifying loan balances are waived as per the notification and portal criteria of the Government of UP.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Small and marginal farmer families in Uttar Pradesh
  • Outstanding eligible farm loans from notified institutions
  • Applicants should not have availed earlier waiver benefits as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Eligible farmers are identified through the state agriculture and cooperative departments
  2. The waiver is applied to the loan account at the bank
  3. Farmers can check their status at the bank or the state portal

The Swami Vivekananda Yojana (formerly UP Free Laptop/Tablet Yojana) distributes free tablet PCs to meritorious students of Uttar Pradesh to promote digital literacy and skill development.

Key Highlights

  • Free tablet PCs distributed to eligible students (no laptops or smartphones in current phase)
  • Target: 25 lakh tablets approved for distribution
  • Students do NOT register directly — colleges upload data, students complete eKYC via Meri Pehchaan portal
  • Eligible: regular students in UG/PG/diploma/ITI/medical/technical courses in UP institutions

How it Works

Distribution managed via DigiShakti portal by UPDESCO. Ongoing distribution rounds in 2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Regular students enrolled in UG, PG, diploma, ITI, medical, or technical courses in UP institutions
  • Merit and course criteria as notified by the department
  • Students must complete eKYC through the Meri Pehchaan portal

How to Apply

  1. No direct registration by students; colleges upload eligible student data
  2. Students complete the eKYC on the Meri Pehchaan portal
  3. Tablets are distributed through the DigiShakti portal by UPDESCO as per the rounds

Mukhyamantri Pension Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh social security scheme providing a monthly pension to elderly citizens, widowed women and persons with disabilities from poor and marginalised families.

Key Highlights

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities
  • Implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of UP
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to beneficiary bank / post office accounts

How it Works

Eligible beneficiaries are enrolled and pension is credited directly to their accounts, as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities in Uttar Pradesh
  • Belonging to poor and marginalised families as per the scheme norms
  • Not covered by any other pension scheme of the same nature

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social welfare office or the state portal
  2. Submit age, identity, and family income details
  3. Pension is credited monthly through DBT after approval

Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh government accident insurance scheme for farmers, providing financial assistance to the farmer family in the event of accidental death or disability.

Key Highlights

  • Cover for registered farmers against accidental death / disability
  • Financial assistance to the farmer family
  • Implemented through the Agriculture / Revenue departments, Government of UP

How it Works

Registered farmers are covered; on an accident, the family claims assistance as per the official portal procedure.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Registered farmers of Uttar Pradesh covered under the state farmer database
  • Cover for accidental death and disability as per the scheme
  • Claims must be filed within the prescribed period

How to Apply

  1. On an accident, the family files a claim with the empanelled insurer or the district agriculture office
  2. Submit the FIR, post-mortem or medical report, and farmer registration details
  3. The assistance is credited to the nominee's bank account after verification

UP Jan Arogya Yojana is the Uttar Pradesh state health protection scheme providing health cover to eligible poor and vulnerable families for cashless treatment.

Key Highlights

  • Cashless treatment at empanelled government and private hospitals
  • Cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation
  • Portable across empanelled hospitals in Uttar Pradesh

How it Works

Eligible families are identified and issued health cards; treatment is cashless at empanelled hospitals, as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Poor and vulnerable families identified as per the state health scheme norms
  • Families enrolled under the scheme are issued health cards
  • Treatment is covered at empanelled hospitals across Uttar Pradesh

How to Apply

  1. Check eligibility at the district health office or the state portal
  2. Complete the enrolment and receive the family health card
  3. Admit the patient at an empanelled hospital and avail cashless treatment with the card

UP Urban Housing Scheme is the Uttar Pradesh state urban housing initiative to provide pucca houses and financial assistance to eligible poor and weaker-section families in urban areas.

Key Highlights

  • Financial assistance / housing for eligible urban poor families
  • Convergent with Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban where applicable
  • Ownership preferential in the name of the woman of the household

How it Works

Eligible families apply through the urban local body / housing department; assistance is released in instalments as per the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Poor and weaker-section families in urban areas of UP
  • Families without a pucca house in the urban area
  • Priority for women-headed households and disadvantaged groups

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the urban local body or the state housing portal
  2. Submit beneficiary details and property documents
  3. Assistance is released in instalments as per the approved plan

Bal Shramik Vidya Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh government scheme to support the education of children of labourers / workers by providing financial assistance and incentives for school enrolment and continuity.

Key Highlights

  • Education support / stipend to children of labourers
  • Aimed at enrolment, retention and reducing child labour
  • Implemented through the Labour / Education departments, Government of UP

How it Works

Eligible children are enrolled and provided assistance / incentives as per the official portal criteria.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Children of labourers and workers in Uttar Pradesh
  • Families identified through the labour department records
  • School enrolment and attendance requirements as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the district labour office or the education department
  2. Submit the parent's worker identity and the child's school details
  3. Assistance is credited to the family or disbursed through the school

Saat Nishchay (the "Seven Resolves") is a flagship governance programme of the Bihar government aimed at inclusive development of every gram panchayat and ward. It guarantees basic public services to citizens.

The 7 Resolves

  • Ghar Tak Pakki Sadak - pucca road to every home
  • Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal - piped drinking water to every home
  • Sauchalay Nirman - household toilets
  • Nishchay Matritva - safe motherhood and child health
  • Kushal Yuva - skill training for youth
  • Student Credit Card - education loan support
  • Greenery and clean environment in every settlement

Objective

To deliver universal basic infrastructure and services so that no household in Bihar is left without roads, water, toilets, electricity and a clean environment.

Eligibility Criteria

  • All residents of Bihar benefit from the seven resolves
  • Specific schemes under Saat Nishchay have their own eligibility norms
  • Enrolment is done through the panchayat or ward office

How to Apply

  1. Citizens apply for the respective resolve through the panchayat, ward office, or the state portal
  2. Department officials verify eligibility and sanction the service
  3. Roads, water, toilets, and other works are delivered through the line departments

Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCC) is a flagship education scheme of the Bihar government to help students pursue higher and professional education without financial hardship. The state government acts as a guarantor for the education loan.

Key Features

  • Education loan of up to Rs. 4 lakh
  • Covers professional courses, computer certificate courses, CA, CFA, ICWA and recognised higher studies
  • Loan disbursed through the Bihar Education Finance Corporation
  • Repayment begins after course completion with a grace period

Objective

To raise the state Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) for higher education by removing the cost barrier for meritorious students.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students who are permanent residents of Bihar
  • Admission to a recognised higher or professional course
  • Admission through merit as per the course norms

How to Apply

  1. Apply online through the Bihar Student Credit Card portal
  2. Upload admission letter, marksheet, and family details
  3. The loan is processed through the Bihar Education Finance Corporation and the bank

Jeevika is the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS), the implementing agency under the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Project. It is among the largest rural livelihoods initiatives in the world, organising rural women into self-help groups (SHGs) for access to credit, livelihoods and entrepreneurship.

Key Features

  • Formation and strengthening of women self-help groups (SHGs) and their federations
  • Access to bank credit and livelihood diversification
  • Support for farm and non-farm enterprises
  • Convergence with state schemes for women and rural development

Eligibility Criteria

  • Rural women of Bihar willing to join a self help group
  • Group formation of 10 to 20 members in the village
  • Members commit to regular savings and meeting attendance

How to Apply

  1. Contact the Jeevika block mission unit or village organisation
  2. Form or join a self help group in your village
  3. The group is linked to the bank for savings and credit after grading

The Bihar Agriculture Road Map is the state agriculture policy framework that guides farmer support, input subsidy, irrigation expansion and crop diversification to increase agricultural productivity and farmer income across Bihar.

Key Features

  • Farmer support and agricultural input subsidy
  • Irrigation development and water-use efficiency
  • Promotion of better seeds, technology and crop diversification
  • Convergence with central schemes such as PM-KISAN where applicable

Exact subsidy amounts and eligibility are as per the official agriculture department notification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Farmers of Bihar engaged in notified crops and activities
  • Benefit norms vary by component such as input subsidy or irrigation
  • Convergence with central schemes applies where eligible

How to Apply

  1. Farmers apply through the district agriculture office or the state portal
  2. Submit land and crop details for the applicable component
  3. Subsidy and support are disbursed as per the approved norms

Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojana (MNSSBY) is a Bihar government scheme to support educated unemployed youth during their job search and skill development.

Key Features

  • Monthly unemployment allowance to educated unemployed youth
  • Provided for a defined period while the beneficiary seeks employment
  • Linked with skill training and registration on the state portal

Objective

To provide financial support to unemployed youth so they are not forced into distress while seeking employment.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educated unemployed youth of Bihar within the eligible age group
  • Registration on the state employment portal
  • Family income and qualification criteria as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Register on the state employment portal with qualification details
  2. Apply for the allowance under the scheme
  3. The allowance is credited monthly through DBT during the eligible period

The Bihar Old Age Pension Scheme is a social security programme of the Bihar government providing a monthly pension to eligible senior citizens so they have a steady income in old age.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens
  • Implemented through the Social Welfare Department, Bihar
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens of Bihar above the eligible age
  • Belonging to poor families as per the state norms
  • Not covered by any other old age pension

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social welfare office or through the state portal
  2. Submit age proof, identity, and family details
  3. Pension is credited monthly through DBT after approval

Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana Bihar is the state housing initiative to provide pucca houses and financial assistance to eligible poor and weaker-section families in Bihar.

Key Features

  • Pucca house / financial assistance to eligible families
  • Convergent with PM Awas Yojana where applicable
  • Ownership preferential in the name of the woman of the household

Assistance amount and eligibility are as per the official notification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Poor and weaker-section families in Bihar without a pucca house
  • Identification through the state housing survey
  • Priority for women-headed households and disadvantaged groups

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the gram panchayat or the state housing portal
  2. Submit beneficiary details and land documents
  3. Assistance is released in instalments linked to construction progress

Beneficiaries should ensure the house is constructed as per the approved plan to receive the full instalments, and should keep the land and identity documents ready while applying.

Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana is a Bihar government health-assistance scheme to provide free or subsidised treatment to eligible residents at government hospitals.

Key Features

  • Free / assisted treatment at government hospitals
  • Support for specified medical conditions as per the scheme
  • Managed through the state health department framework

Covered treatments and assistance amounts are as per the official notification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Residents of Bihar covered under the scheme's health assistance norms
  • Coverage for specified medical conditions and treatments
  • Treatment at government hospitals as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the hospital or the district health office
  2. Submit medical reports and the doctor's recommendation
  3. Assistance is provided as per the approved treatment plan

Balika Protsahan Yojana is a Bihar government scheme to encourage the education of the girl child by providing a financial incentive on continuation of studies.

Key Features

  • Financial incentive to girls for education
  • Aimed at reducing dropout among girls
  • Promotes continuation of education up to higher classes

Exact incentive amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girl children of Bihar enrolled in school
  • Continuation of studies in the notified classes
  • Family income and category criteria as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the school or the district education office
  2. Submit the girl's enrolment and attendance details
  3. The incentive is disbursed as per the scheme's schedule

Parents should ensure the girl's attendance is maintained because the incentive is verified against school records before each instalment is released.

Bihar Kanya Vivah Yojana is a state scheme to support the marriage of daughters from poor and weaker-section families by providing a marriage grant / assistance.

Key Features

  • Financial grant / assistance for the marriage of an eligible girl
  • Aimed at reducing the financial burden of marriage on poor families
  • Implemented through the Social Welfare / Women Welfare Department, Bihar

The grant amount and eligibility are as per the official notification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girls from poor and weaker-section families of Bihar
  • Marriage registered as per the scheme norms
  • Age of the bride as per the legal minimum

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social welfare office or the state portal
  2. Submit the marriage details and family documents
  3. The grant is credited to the beneficiary's account after verification

Jeevika Sakhi Mandal is the women self-help group (SHG) bank-linkage component of the Jeevika mission in Bihar. It connects women SHGs to the formal banking system for savings, credit and financial inclusion.

Key Features

  • Bank linkage of women SHGs for savings and credit
  • Group and member-level loans for livelihoods
  • Financial literacy and inclusion of rural women
  • Convergence with Jeevika / BRLPS institutions

Eligibility Criteria

  • Women SHGs formed under the Jeevika mission in Bihar
  • Groups with regular savings and meeting discipline
  • Grading of the group for bank linkage

How to Apply

  1. Join a Jeevika self help group in your village
  2. The group completes the grading process through the block mission unit
  3. The bank sanctions group loans after grading and the credit is used for livelihoods

Regular weekly meetings and monthly savings are the foundation of the group, and grading by the block mission unit is the key step before the bank sanctions the loan.

Overview

Cover of Rs. 1.5 lakh per family per year (base); Rs. 2.5 lakh for senior citizens and critical illnesses; Rs. 5 lakh when integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY

Eligibility Criteria

  • Families covered under the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana beneficiary list
  • Cover of Rs 1.5 lakh per family per year (base), Rs 2.5 lakh for senior citizens and critical illnesses, and Rs 5 lakh when integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
  • Beneficiaries are identified from the state's eligible family database

How to Apply

  1. Check your family's eligibility on the MJPJAY portal or the state health agency
  2. Receive or download the family health card
  3. Avail cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals with the card

Beneficiaries should keep the family health card and Aadhaar ready at the time of hospital admission, and should confirm the empanelled hospital list on the state health agency portal before treatment.

MahaDBT (Maharashtra Direct Benefit Transfer) is the unified scholarship and benefit portal of the Government of Maharashtra. The Post-Matric Scholarship component supports students from SC, ST, OBC, SBC, VJNT, Minority and (income-based) open categories who are pursuing education after matriculation.

Key Features

  • Single-window online application for multiple state scholarship schemes
  • Coverage of tuition fee and maintenance allowance as per category and course norms
  • Direct Benefit Transfer of sanctioned amount to the student bank account
  • Renewal and fresh applications handled on the same portal

Objective

To promote higher education among backward and economically weaker sections by reducing the financial burden of tuition and living costs.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students of Maharashtra from SC, ST, OBC, SBC, VJNT, minority, and income-based open categories
  • Pursuing post-matric courses in recognised institutions
  • Income and renewal criteria as per the scholarship norms

How to Apply

  1. Register on the MahaDBT portal
  2. Fill the post-matric scholarship application with course and bank details
  3. Upload documents and submit for approval
  4. Sanctioned amounts are credited directly to the student's bank account

Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana is a Maharashtra state scheme launched in 2024 providing free LPG cylinders to women beneficiaries.

Key Features

  • 3 free 14.2 kg LPG cylinders per year
  • For women with PM Ujjwala or Majhi Ladki Bahin connections
  • Implemented by the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Department, Maharashtra

Note

This is different from the central government Annapurna Scheme (NFSA) which provides 10 kg free food grains to destitute senior citizens aged 65+. The Maharashtra scheme focuses on LPG fuel support for women.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Women beneficiaries of PM Ujjwala or Majhi Ladki Bahin in Maharashtra
  • Households without an existing LPG connection benefit
  • Eligibility as per the state department norms

How to Apply

  1. Eligible women are identified through the department's beneficiary lists
  2. The free cylinders are delivered through the LPG distributor
  3. Beneficiaries can check the entitlement at the district civil supplies office

Shiv Bhojan Thali is a Maharashtra government initiative to provide a hot, nutritious, subsidised meal to citizens from economically weaker sections at a nominal price. The scheme is operated through empanelled canteens / centres across the state.

Key Features

  • Nutritious Thali at a highly subsidised rate (Rs. 10 nominal charge)
  • Available through designated Shiv Bhojan centres in urban and rural areas
  • Aims to make at least one balanced meal affordable for the poor

Objective

To fight hunger and malnutrition by guaranteeing an affordable cooked meal to every needy citizen.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Citizens from economically weaker sections of Maharashtra
  • Meal available at Rs 10 at designated Shiv Bhojan centres
  • No prior registration is generally required

How to Apply

  1. Visit a designated Shiv Bhojan centre in your area
  2. Pay the nominal charge and receive the thali
  3. The meal is served during the centre's fixed hours

Mahatma Phule Karj Mafi Yojana is the Maharashtra government farm-loan waiver scheme intended to relieve distress among small and marginal farmers by waiving eligible outstanding agricultural loans.

Key Features

  • Waiver of eligible short-term agricultural loans for qualifying farmers
  • Relief delivered through participating banks / cooperative credit institutions
  • Benefit amount and eligibility capped as per the official notification

Objective

To reduce the indebtedness of small and marginal farmers and support agricultural revival.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Small and marginal farmers of Maharashtra
  • Eligible outstanding short-term agricultural loans as per the notification
  • Farmers should not have availed earlier waiver benefits as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Eligible farmers are identified through the banks and cooperative institutions
  2. The waiver is adjusted in the farmer's loan account
  3. Farmers can verify the relief at their bank branch

Mukhyamantri Gram Sadak Yojana (Chief Minister's Rural Road Scheme) is a Maharashtra state programme to provide all-weather pucca road connectivity to rural villages and habitations that lack it.

Key Features

  • Construction / upgradation of all-weather pucca roads to eligible habitations
  • Civic connectivity to markets, schools, health centres and block headquarters
  • Implemented through the state Rural Development / Public Works machinery

Objective

To improve last-mile rural connectivity and integrate villages with the economic mainstream.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Habitations of Maharashtra without all-weather road connectivity
  • Eligibility of habitations as per the state's road connectivity norms
  • No individual application is required

How to Apply

  1. Road works are planned by the state rural development and public works departments
  2. Villages and habitations are covered as per the state's priority list
  3. Beneficiaries gain road connectivity once the works are completed

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) is implemented in Maharashtra as a central-state joint housing mission. Maharashtra implements both PMAY-Gramin (rural) and PMAY-Urban components.

Key Features

  • PMAY-Gramin: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plain) / Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/tribal) central assistance for house construction
  • PMAY-Urban 2.0: Credit-linked subsidy and beneficiary-led construction support
  • 60:40 central:state funding ratio
  • Implemented through Maharashtra Rural Development Dept and Urban Development Dept

Note

This is a central government scheme (PMAY) implemented in Maharashtra, not a standalone state scheme.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Beneficiaries under PMAY-Gramin and PMAY-Urban in Maharashtra
  • Families without a pucca house and meeting the scheme's income norms
  • Identification through the housing survey and beneficiary lists

How to Apply

  1. Apply for PMAY-Gramin through the gram panchayat or the Awaas+ portal
  2. Apply for PMAY-Urban through the urban local body or the PMAY-U portal
  3. Submit documents and complete verification to receive the assistance

Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree Yojana is a Maharashtra government scheme for the welfare of the girl child. It provides conditional incentives / benefits to encourage the education and well-being of girl children and to promote the girl-child sex ratio.

Key Features

  • Conditional benefit / incentive for eligible girl children in the family
  • Encourages education and continued schooling of the girl child
  • Promotes awareness against female foeticide

Objective

To secure the future of the girl child through financial support linked to education and upbringing.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girl child born in eligible families of Maharashtra
  • Conditional benefits linked to birth registration, immunisation, and education milestones
  • Family income and category norms as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the district women and child development office or the state portal
  2. Submit the birth certificate and family details
  3. Benefits are released at the notified milestones after verification

The Maharashtra Employment Guarantee scheme is the state implementation of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), providing a legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for such work.

Key Features

  • Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per household per year
  • Wages paid to the bank / post-office account of the worker
  • Unemployment allowance if work is not provided within the stipulated period
  • One-third of the work force reserved for women

Objective

To enhance livelihood security in rural Maharashtra through guaranteed wage employment and durable asset creation.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Rural households of Maharashtra whose adult members volunteer for work
  • Work demanded as per the MGNREGA process
  • One third of the workforce reserved for women

How to Apply

  1. Register at the gram panchayat and obtain an NREGA job card
  2. Submit the demand for work in writing
  3. Work is allotted within 15 days and wages are paid to the bank account

Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana is a Maharashtra social-security scheme providing a monthly pension to destitute persons who have no means of subsistence and are not covered by any other pension scheme.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to destitute, disabled, widows, elderly and transgender persons
  • Benefit for those without any other source of support
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary account

Objective

To provide a basic social-security net to the most vulnerable and unsupported sections of society.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Destitute persons in Maharashtra without any means of subsistence
  • Includes elderly, disabled, widows, and transgender persons
  • Not covered by any other pension scheme of the same nature

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social welfare office or the state portal
  2. Submit identity, income, and category details
  3. The pension is credited monthly through DBT after approval

Sambal Yojana (Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan) is a comprehensive social security scheme of the Madhya Pradesh government for unorganised workers, providing multiple benefits under one umbrella.

Key Benefits

  • Free 200 units of electricity per month
  • Accident death/disability insurance: Rs. 2-4 lakh
  • Maternity assistance: Rs. 16,000 (4 installments of Rs. 4,000)
  • Funeral assistance: Rs. 5,000
  • Free education for children of beneficiaries

Objective

To provide a comprehensive social security net to unorganised and informal-sector workers of Madhya Pradesh.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Unorganised workers of Madhya Pradesh registered under the scheme
  • Family income and registration criteria as per the scheme
  • Benefits are linked to the worker's registration status

How to Apply

  1. Register on the Sambal portal or at the district labour office
  2. Complete the biometric and family details
  3. Benefits such as electricity, insurance, and maternity assistance are delivered as per the schedule

Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana (MMKSY) is a Madhya Pradesh state scheme providing incentive payments above the Minimum Support Price (MSP) to registered farmers who sell eligible produce at government procurement centres.

Key Features

  • Per-quintal MSP incentive payments to farmers
  • For wheat, paddy, and other notified crops sold at procurement centres
  • Distinct from Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (which provides direct income support of Rs. 6,000/year)
  • Implemented by Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP

Objective

To incentivise farmers to sell produce at government procurement centres and ensure they receive remunerative prices above MSP.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Farmers of Madhya Pradesh registered in the farmer database
  • Sale of notified crops at government procurement centres
  • Produce quality and quantity as per the procurement norms

How to Apply

  1. Register on the state farmer portal with land and bank details
  2. Sell the eligible produce at the designated procurement centre
  3. The MSP plus incentive is credited to the bank account after the sale

Gaon Ki Beti / Pratibha Kiran Yojana is a Madhya Pradesh government scheme to encourage the education of the girl child by providing a financial incentive for continuation of studies.

Key Features

  • Financial incentive to girls for education
  • Aimed at reducing dropout among girls
  • Promotes continuation of education up to higher classes

Exact incentive amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girl children of Madhya Pradesh enrolled in school
  • Continuation of studies in the notified classes
  • Family income and category criteria as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the school or the district education office
  2. Submit the girl's enrolment and attendance details
  3. The incentive is disbursed as per the scheme's schedule

Parents should ensure the girl's attendance is maintained because the incentive is verified against school records before each instalment is released.

Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana is a Madhya Pradesh government scheme promoting self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance and training support to set up enterprises.

Key Features

  • Financial / subsidy support for youth to start self-employment ventures
  • Training and handholding for enterprise setup
  • Aimed at reducing youth unemployment in the state

Exact subsidy amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Youth of Madhya Pradesh in the eligible age group
  • Educational qualification and project viability criteria
  • New self-employment ventures in manufacturing, services, or trading

How to Apply

  1. Prepare a project proposal with cost estimates
  2. Apply through the district industry centre or the state portal
  3. Complete the selection process and receive the assistance through the bank

MP e-District Services is the Madhya Pradesh government online platform for delivering citizen-centric services such as income certificates, caste certificates, residence certificates, and other government services.

Key Features

  • Online application and tracking for certificates and services
  • Reduces the need to visit government offices physically
  • Transparent, time-bound service delivery

Eligibility Criteria

  • Residents of Madhya Pradesh applying for state certificates and services
  • Documents required vary by service
  • Aadhaar is used for authentication where required

How to Apply

  1. Register on the MP e-District portal
  2. Select the service and fill the application
  3. Upload documents and track the application status
  4. Download the issued certificate once approved

Citizens can also avail assisted application at Common Service Centres, and should keep the acknowledgement number to track the application status on the portal.

The Madhya Pradesh Old Age / Widow / Disabled Pension Scheme is a social security programme of the state government providing a monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and disabled persons
  • Implemented through the Social Justice / Social Welfare Department
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities of Madhya Pradesh
  • Belonging to poor families as per the state norms
  • Not covered by any other pension of the same nature

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social justice office or the state portal
  2. Submit age, identity, and family details
  3. Pension is credited monthly through DBT after approval

Khadya Sathi is the food security programme of the Government of West Bengal aimed at ensuring that no one in the state goes to bed hungry. It provides subsidised food grains to ration card holders.

Key Features

  • Rice / wheat at ₹2 per kg to eligible ration card holders
  • Coverage of the majority of the state population under NFSA and state top-up
  • Distribution through Fair Price Shops (FPS)
  • Convergence with Aadhaar for beneficiary authentication

Objective

To achieve near-universal food security in West Bengal by providing affordable food grains to every eligible household.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Ration card holders of West Bengal covered under NFSA and the state top-up
  • Households listed in the state's food security database
  • Distribution through fair price shops

How to Apply

  1. Visit your designated fair price shop with the ration card
  2. Authenticate the beneficiary through Aadhaar where applicable
  3. Receive the monthly entitlement of rice or wheat at the subsidised rate

Duare Sarkar (Government at the Doorstep) is a citizen outreach campaign of the Government of West Bengal that sets up camps at the gram panchayat / municipal ward level to deliver government services and scheme benefits directly to citizens.

Key Features

  • On-the-spot enrolment and application for multiple state schemes
  • Issuance / correction of caste, income, domicile and other certificates
  • Enrolment under Swasthya Sathi, Khadya Sathi and social security pensions
  • Camp-based service with department officials present at the venue

Objective

To take government services to the doorstep of citizens and improve last-mile delivery and awareness of welfare schemes.

Eligibility Criteria

  • All citizens of West Bengal seeking state services
  • Services are provided on the spot at the camps
  • Documents as required for each scheme

How to Apply

  1. Check the Duare Sarkar camp schedule for your panchayat or ward
  2. Visit the camp with the required documents
  3. Complete the enrolment or application on the spot with the officials present

Yuvashree is a West Bengal government scheme providing a monthly unemployment allowance to educated unemployed youth who are registered with the state employment bank, to support them while they seek suitable employment.

Key Features

  • Monthly allowance of ₹1,500 to eligible unemployed youth
  • For educated youth registered with the West Bengal employment bank
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

Objective

To provide financial support to educated unemployed youth and encourage them to register, train and seek employment.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educated unemployed youth of West Bengal in the eligible age group
  • Registration with the state employment bank
  • Family income and qualification criteria as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Register with the West Bengal employment bank
  2. Apply for the Yuvashree allowance as per the eligibility
  3. The allowance is credited monthly through DBT

Rupashree Prakalpa is a West Bengal government scheme providing a one-time marriage grant to eligible poor families for the marriage of their daughters, to reduce the financial burden of marriage.

Key Features

  • One-time financial assistance of ₹25,000 per eligible girl at the time of marriage
  • Targeted at girls from economically weaker families
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

Objective

To provide financial support to poor families for the marriage of their daughters and discourage child marriage.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Girls from economically weaker families of West Bengal
  • Marriage registered as per the scheme norms
  • Age of the bride as per the legal minimum

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the district social welfare office or the state portal
  2. Submit the marriage and family details
  3. The grant of Rs 25,000 is credited to the beneficiary's account after verification

The West Bengal Student Credit Card (WBSCC) scheme provides education loans of up to ₹10 lakh to students of the state for pursuing higher and professional education, with repayment beginning after course completion.

Key Features

  • Education loan of up to ₹10 lakh
  • Covers tuition, course and related educational expenses
  • Moratorium during the study period and flexible repayment tenure
  • Interest subvention / relaxations as per scheme norms

Objective

To remove the financial barrier to higher education for students of West Bengal and raise the state’s gross enrolment ratio.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students who are permanent residents of West Bengal
  • Admission to a recognised higher or professional course
  • Co-borrower or guarantor requirements as per the bank norms

How to Apply

  1. Apply online through the West Bengal Student Credit Card portal
  2. Upload the admission letter, marksheet, and family details
  3. The loan is processed through the participating bank and disbursed to the institution

The West Bengal social security pension covers old age pension, widow pension and disability pension, providing a monthly pension to vulnerable sections so they have a steady income in old age or distress.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities
  • Implemented through the Department of Social Welfare
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities of West Bengal
  • Belonging to families as per the state's social security norms
  • Not covered by any other pension of the same nature

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the district social welfare office or through the Duare Sarkar camps
  2. Submit age, identity, and family details
  3. Pension is credited monthly through DBT after approval

Sikshashree is a West Bengal government stipend scheme for students belonging to minority communities, aimed at reducing dropout and encouraging continuation of schooling.

Key Features

  • Stipend to eligible minority students (classes I to VIII and as notified)
  • Encourages retention of minority students in school
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary / guardian account

Exact stipend amount and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students of West Bengal belonging to minority communities
  • Enrolled in classes I to VIII and other notified classes
  • Attendance and family norms as per the scheme

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the school or the district minority welfare office
  2. Submit the student's enrolment and community details
  3. The stipend is credited to the beneficiary or guardian account as per the schedule
